module: Flowgraph node 'Foreach' (macro, logic category). For each element of the input table, loads a new flowgraph (.flow.json file given by 'elementFile') with core_flowgraphManager.loadManager, sets mgr.modules.foreach.key/value (read by the Get Foreach node) and starts execution. Does this only once (flag self.done).
notes: BUG: work reads self.pinIn.filepath.value whereas the pin is named 'elementFile' (pinIn.filepath is nil, likely crash).
BUG: in _executionStopped, the loop names the variable 'mrg' but uses 'mgr:setRunning(false)' (nil global variable) and removeNextFrame(self.mgr) (the parent manager, not the child).
self.done is never set back to false.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

postInit.desc: Restricts the elementFile pin to '.flow.json' files.

_executionStopped.desc: If destroyTargetOnStop, stops and deletes the created managers; clears targets.

work.desc: On the first flow, creates and starts one manager per element of the table; self.done prevents starting again.
